messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

function.name: get_co_ordinate

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
So when it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 p.m. the same day in Berlin.  
(The difference stays 9 hours year‑round because both regions observe daylight‑saving time at the same time.)
message.reasoning: User asks: "What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?" We need to answer. Los Angeles is in Pacific Time Zone (PT), Berlin is Central European Time (CET). But daylight saving changes. Usually difference is 9 hours (Berlin ahead). But during DST, Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-7) and Berlin is CEST (UTC+2) difference 9 hours. During standard time, Los Angeles PST (UTC-8) and Berlin CET (UTC+1) difference 9 hours. So always 9 hours. But if one is on DST and other not? Actually both observe DST simultaneously but offset difference remains 9 hours. So answer: Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. Provide explanation. No function needed.
